title: Shiroi Youso — Confluence of Five
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Fire + Lightning classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Fire and Lightning jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Elemental amplification (two compounding 35% five-element self Increase Damage Given buffs on Fire Release and Wind Release, a third on the injected Voltari for Earth, Lightning and Water hits; two 35% five-element exposures on Fire Release and Element Divine's area, raised only at the Foundation)
emphasis.secondary: Burst and burn on the marked target (Damage on Lightning Release 40 and Element Divine 45 EP, held to +2; Afterburn on the same two casts, 35% and 30%)
emphasis.tertiary: Defensive control (self Decrease Damage Taken on Wind Release and Earth Release; static Heal on Water Release)
emphasis.rationale: Eleven supported rows sit on six casts. The highest-leverage rows are the paired five-element percentage rows: two self Increase Damage Given buffs and two exposures, each multiplying every five-element hit in the two rounds after its cast, injected children included, and compounding with one another. The tree therefore splits by who gains. Fivefold Kindling marks the target (+2% exposure, the tree's only exposure bonus) and asks "How do I finish the target I mark: strike it down with my own blows, or burn it so every hit on it feeds the fire?": a self-buff setup with a controlled +2 Damage payoff (Divine Convergence) or Afterburn that allies' hits feed too (White Immolation). Pale Vessel strengthens the caster ("How do I strengthen myself: strike harder or stand firmer?") and forks into the compounding self damage buffs (White Maelstrom) and the compounding self Decrease Damage Taken buffs with Water Release's Heal (Eye of the Tempest); both pairs stop at +8%. Flat Damage stops at +2 because the kit's Damage rows are 40 and 45 EP: +5 would lift Lightning Release to 45 and Element Divine to 50. Potency scope is multi-element pending director review: Fire and Lightning (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: Fivefold Kindling
nodes.flavor: Five elements, one white spark. Whatever the clan marks becomes kindling.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure on Fire Release (single target) and Element Divine's area (ally hazard) 35 → 37%, live the two rounds after each cast; the tree's only exposure bonus.

nodes.name: Gathering Palm
nodes.flavor: Five currents drawn into one palm and held there, waiting for the strike.
nodes.coverage_note: Setup for Divine Convergence: Fire Release and Wind Release self damage buffs 35 → 38% (40% with Pale Vessel), live the two rounds after each 40 AP cast; the caster's five-element hits only, nothing on Element Divine's area.

nodes.name: Divine Convergence
nodes.flavor: When all five currents meet in one hand, the sky itself gives way.
nodes.coverage_note: Controlled payoff: Lightning Release 40 → 42 and Element Divine 45 → 47 EP on every cast, no buff window or burn needed (no tier crossed; 60 AP each, cooldown 7). Element Divine's area damage hits enemies only.

nodes.name: Charred Current
nodes.flavor: Lightning leaves a charred path, and fire remembers the way.
nodes.coverage_note: Afterburn debuff: Lightning Release 35 → 38%, Element Divine 30 → 33% (area, ally hazard); 2 rounds; raises the percent, not the duration.

nodes.name: White Immolation
nodes.flavor: Not a flame that burns, but a whiteness that consumes what the flame has touched.
nodes.coverage_note: Burn: Afterburn Lightning Release 35 → 45% and Element Divine 30 → 40% on the full route (+10%); every non-pierce hit the target takes in the two rounds after the cast, allies' and injected children's included, adds that share (60% cap per hit).

nodes.name: Pale Vessel
nodes.flavor: The body is only the vessel; the five currents decide whether it strikes or stands.
nodes.coverage_note: Self Increase Damage Given on Fire Release and Wind Release 35 → 37%; self Decrease Damage Taken on Wind Release and Earth Release 35 → 37%; all four land on the caster, live the two rounds after each cast.

nodes.name: Gale Bulwark
nodes.flavor: The wind does not stop the blade; it carries the blade past you.
nodes.coverage_note: Both self Decrease Damage Taken rows 37 → 40% with Pale Vessel (all four stat types, element-less: every non-pierce hit); realized on the caster at cast time.

nodes.name: Eye of the Tempest
nodes.flavor: At the storm's heart the air is still, and the tide mends whatever the wind lets through.
nodes.coverage_note: Fortress with sustain: Wind Release and Earth Release 35 → 43% Decrease Damage Taken on the full route (+8%; both live, incoming ×0.57 × 0.57 ≈ ×0.32, ×0.42 unmodified); Water Release Heal 25 → 30 (300 HP per tick on the two following rounds).

nodes.name: Rising Currents
nodes.flavor: Each element poured into the vessel lifts the next.
nodes.coverage_note: Both self damage buffs 37 → 39% with Pale Vessel (Fire Release, Wind Release); five-element hits only.

nodes.name: White Maelstrom
nodes.flavor: Five currents turning as one; nothing thrown from inside it lands softly.
nodes.coverage_note: Amplification: Fire Release and Wind Release self buffs 35 → 43% on the full route (+8%); with both live every five-element caster hit lands ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04 (×1.82 unmodified), injected children's included.

examples.name: Divine Convergence
examples.rationale: Lightning Release 42 and Element Divine 47 EP on every cast (no tier crossed), no window or burn needed. Gathering Palm and Pale Vessel put both self buffs at 40%: inside both windows Lightning Release lands 42 × 1.40 × 1.40 ≈ 82 against 40 × 1.35 × 1.35 ≈ 73 unbuilt (×1.13); outside them the +2 alone is ×1.05. Fivefold Kindling's 37% marks add ×1.37 each. Against White Maelstrom with Fivefold Kindling the Damage rows come out even inside the windows (×3.86 against ×3.84 on a doubly marked target with both self buffs live); Divine Convergence keeps its +2 outside them, White Maelstrom wins on the caster's other five-element hits. Pale Vessel is the fourth purchase (37% Decrease Damage Taken too); Charred Current (Afterburn 38% / 33%) is the all-offence alternative.

examples.name: White Immolation
examples.rationale: Afterburn at 45% on Lightning Release's target and 40% on Element Divine's area (+10%). In the two rounds after Lightning Release every non-pierce hit the stunned target takes, allies' hits and the injected Voltari and Planetary Devastation included, adds 45% of itself. The two burns together pass the 60% per-hit cap (85%; 65% unmodified), so the route pays when the casts alternate. This is the team route: an ally's five-element hit on Element Divine's target with that burn live lands ×1.37 × 1.40 ≈ ×1.92, against ×1.37 × 1.33 ≈ ×1.82 for Divine Convergence with Charred Current and ×1.35 × 1.30 ≈ ×1.76 unmodified. Pale Vessel is the fourth purchase (self buffs and Decrease Damage Taken 37%); Gathering Palm (self buffs 38%) is the all-offence alternative and adds no exposure.

examples.name: White Maelstrom
examples.rationale: Both self buffs at 43% (Pale Vessel +2%, Rising Currents +2%, White Maelstrom +4%). Cast Fire Release and Wind Release (80 AP) and for the next two rounds every five-element hit the caster lands, on any target and from any jutsu, injected children included, is multiplied ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04; the bloodline passive multiplies last. Voltari's own buff, also 43%, makes a third for Earth, Lightning and Water hits in the two rounds after it is cast (×1.43³ ≈ ×2.92), which neither of the kit's Damage rows collects. Fivefold Kindling is the offensive fourth (exposures 37%); Gale Bulwark (Decrease Damage Taken 40%) is the defensive one.

examples.name: Eye of the Tempest
examples.rationale: Both self Decrease Damage Taken buffs at 43% (Pale Vessel +2%, Gale Bulwark +3%, Eye of the Tempest +3%; incoming ×0.57 each, ×0.32 with both live against ×0.42 unmodified) and Water Release's heal at 300 HP per tick. Rising Currents is the fourth purchase (self buffs 39%), so the fortress still hits; Fivefold Kindling (exposures 37%) is the alternative.

design_notes: 2026-10-04 rebalance (BALANCE_REVIEW_METHOD.md). Rewired by recipient: Fivefold Kindling becomes the target root (+2% Increase Damage Taken; its +2% Increase Damage Given moves to the caster root) and Bedrock and Tide becomes Pale Vessel (+2% Increase Damage Given, +2% Decrease Damage Taken). Re-cut: Pale Lightning (+2 Damage) becomes a Hidden-Art setup and Divine Convergence goes +3 → +2 Damage, because +5 lifted Lightning Release 40 → 45 and Element Divine 45 → 50. Replaced: Tidal Mending (+3% Heal) and Pull of the Undertow (+5% Increase Damage Taken, +2% Decrease Damage Taken), a heal-gated exposure that did not fit a defensive Foundation, by Rising Currents (+2% Increase Damage Given) and White Maelstrom (+4%). White Immolation drops its +2% Increase Damage Taken. Bedrock and Tide's +2% Heal and Tidal Mending's +3% Heal are removed; Eye of the Tempest's +3% Increase Damage Given becomes +5% Heal (Heal maximum unchanged at +5%). Second pass: Eye of the Tempest's Decrease Damage Taken goes +5% → +3% (route +10% → +8%; next note). Final review: the setup, first Opened to the Elements (+3% Increase Damage Taken), becomes Gathering Palm (+3% self Increase Damage Given), because White Immolation's natural fourth bought that exposure on Element Divine's area on top of its Afterburn and took over Divine Convergence's niche (R1). Kept: Charred Current, White Immolation's +7% Afterburn and Gale Bulwark's +3%.

Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Taken +2%, Afterburn +10%, Increase Damage Given +8%, Decrease Damage Taken +8%, Heal +5%; not jointly attainable. Both self pairs compound on one hit, so both caster routes stop at +8%. Increase Damage Given: the double-buff window goes ×1.35² ≈ ×1.82 → ×1.43² ≈ ×2.04, about what Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel gives its Damage rows in the same window (×1.40² × 42/40 ≈ ×2.06). Decrease Damage Taken: incoming with both buffs live goes ×0.65² ≈ ×0.42 → ×0.57² ≈ ×0.32 (+10% would reach ×0.55² ≈ ×0.30). Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality runs 2 + 3 + 5 over two rows, but one is a 15% row on a 60 AP strike; here both are 35% buffs on 40 AP casts, so the tree holds them to the same test as the damage buffs. Exposure stays at the Foundation's +2% (two rows, team-wide) and Afterburn at +10% (the burns do not compound; they share the 60% per-hit cap).

Filters (SOURCE_MECHANICS §3/§3b): the Increase Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken rows list the five elements with no stat filter, so each multiplies five-element damage only, by 1 + power/100 per matching row: the kit's two Damage rows, the five injected children and any other five-element hit; element-less hits get ratio 0. The Decrease Damage Taken rows list all four stat types and no element: every non-pierce hit. The bloodline passive (25% + 0.15/level, five-element) multiplies last.

Delivery: all six casts are cooldown 7; Lightning Release and Element Divine cost 60 AP, the rest 40. Wind and Earth Release's rows are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast time (§4b); Water Release's heal lands on the caster. Every buff and debuff acts only in the two rounds after its cast (§3b), so Element Divine never raises its own hit: a strike sees Fire Release's mark and, for Lightning Release, an earlier Element Divine's.

Fourth purchases: Divine Convergence takes Pale Vessel or Charred Current; White Immolation Pale Vessel or Gathering Palm; White Maelstrom Fivefold Kindling or Gale Bulwark; Eye of the Tempest Rising Currents or Fivefold Kindling. Two pairs share three nodes and differ only in the capstone. On the target, 01+02+03+04 and 01+02+04+05 trade +2 Damage for +7% Afterburn: on the caster's Lightning Release against a target carrying Fire Release's mark and Element Divine's burn they come out even (42 × 1.33 ≈ 56 against 40 × 1.40 = 56); the +2 wins in the opener and while both burns are capped at 60%, the Afterburn on allies' hits. No fourth adds exposure: White Immolation with Pale Vessel or Gathering Palm leaves Element Divine's area at Fivefold Kindling's 37%. On the caster, 06+07+09 then chooses between Eye of the Tempest, about −10% incoming (×0.60² = ×0.36 → ×0.57² ≈ ×0.32 with both buffs live) plus 100 HP per Water Release cast, and White Maelstrom, about +6% output (×1.39² ≈ ×1.93 → ×1.43² ≈ ×2.04). White Maelstrom with Fivefold Kindling and Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel reach about the same multiplier on a caster Damage-row hit against a doubly marked target with both self buffs live (×1.43² × 1.37² ≈ ×3.84 against ×1.40² × 1.37² × 42/40 ≈ ×3.86); White Maelstrom wins on the caster's other five-element hits inside the windows, Divine Convergence on its two strikes outside them (×1.05). No fourth makes a route automatic.
risks: Classification (multi-element: director review): the proposal lists both signature elements on the kit's Damage rows, Fire (Element Divine) and Lightning (Lightning Release), which reaches every jutsu of either element; choosing one element, both, or a classification extension is the director's decision. Sharing these elements with other bloodlines is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). Water Release and Earth Release carry neither element, so Earth Release's Decrease Damage Taken (Pale Vessel, the fortress) and Water Release's Heal (Eye of the Tempest) need an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Fire/Lightning coverage is unverified.

Ally hazard: Element Divine row 1 (Afterburn 30%) and row 2 (exposure 35%) are AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none (=ALL): allies inside the circle also receive the debuffs; the caster never does (§4b). Fivefold Kindling (exposure), Charred Current and White Immolation (Afterburn) raise what allies there take; positioning decides. The Damage row is ENEMIES-only.

Afterburn saturation: Lightning Release 35% and Element Divine 30% already pass the 60% per-hit cap together (65%), so White Immolation's 45% / 40% adds value only while one burn is active. Downstream coverage (every non-pierce hit by anyone for 2 rounds, including the children cast into Lightning Release's 2-round stun) was not simulated; pierce hits take no Afterburn.

Compounding through injected children: Voltari, a SPECIAL Lightning jutsu injected by Lightning Release, is in scope under Fire + Lightning, so its own 35% self Increase Damage Given row (Earth, Lightning, Water; 2 rounds) takes the same bonuses: Earth, Lightning and Water hits in the two rounds after Voltari compound three self buffs (×1.43³ ≈ ×2.92 at White Maelstrom's maximum, ×2.46 unmodified; R3 departure in design_review.concerns). Rising Water Slicer's 35% exposure row (Earth, Fire, Lightning) is in scope too: a third exposure at Fivefold Kindling's 37% (×1.37³ ≈ ×2.57). Not simulated.

Injected children's Damage: under Fire + Lightning, Voltari (40 EP), Great Fire Annihilation (45 EP) and Rising Water Slicer (40 EP) also take Divine Convergence's +2 (42 / 47 / 42: no tier crossed); Planetary Devastation (Earth) and Great Vacuum Bullet (Wind) carry no qualifying element on a supported row. Children are cast at the inject power as level (100/110) and are not counted in this tree's coverage.

Heal scale: one static row, 25 = 250 HP per tick on two following rounds; Eye of the Tempest's +5% adds 50 HP per tick (100 HP per 40 AP cast), small against high-level pools. Absorb (Water) and barrier (Earth) are unsupported and unchanged.
Skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. No combat simulation was performed.

design_review.status: Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved

foundation_sentences.01: How do I finish the target I mark: strike it down with my own blows, or burn it so every hit on it feeds the fire?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I strengthen myself: strike harder or stand firmer?

route_identities.03: burst: self-buff setup, controlled +2 Damage payoff on Lightning Release and Element Divine on every cast
route_identities.05: attrition / team: a burn that every hit on the target feeds, allies' included
route_identities.10: sustained amplification: two compounding self buffs on every five-element hit, injected children included
route_identities.08: fortress with sustain: two compounding self Decrease Damage Taken buffs and Water Release's Heal

design_review.director_review: Classification: the Fire + Lightning multi-element scope remains a director decision (unchanged by this batch); narrowing it to Fire would take Voltari out of scope. For the roster-wide decisions: Eye of the Tempest stops at +8% Decrease Damage Taken on two compounding rows where the fortress anchors use +10%; White Maelstrom keeps +8% Increase Damage Given although Voltari's buff is a third compounding row on Earth, Lightning and Water hits (R3 departure); and Divine Convergence's setup, Gathering Palm, repeats Rising Currents' self Increase Damage Given under the other Foundation (R1/R4 departure). Kit reasons in concerns. No director exception and no Damage row above 50.
concerns: R3 departure: White Maelstrom keeps +8% Increase Damage Given. Voltari is in scope, so its 35% self buff (Earth, Lightning, Water) is a third compounding row on those hits (×1.43³ ≈ ×2.92 against ×2.46 unmodified, ×1.19; R3's +5% would give ×1.40³ ≈ ×2.74). Kit reason: the third row exists only in the two rounds after Voltari is cast, which is only possible in the two rounds after Lightning Release; it skips Fire hits; and neither kit Damage row collects it (Lightning Release is on its cooldown 7, Element Divine is Fire, Voltari never buffs its own hit). Three rows reach only Planetary Devastation, Rising Water Slicer and off-kit Earth, Lightning or Water jutsu, about once per Lightning Release cooldown and only when Fire Release and Wind Release were cast to overlap; the route's ordinary hits see two rows.

Eye of the Tempest stops at +8% Decrease Damage Taken on two compounding 35% rows (both live ×0.57² ≈ ×0.32, ×0.77 of unmodified), slightly lighter than Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality (2 + 3 + 5 with one 15% row, ×0.75 of unmodified, plus a Decrease Damage Given rider). If the director wants the anchor fortress on two strong rows, Eye of the Tempest returns to +5%.

Exposure is held at Fivefold Kindling's +2% on purpose: Divine Convergence's setup is a self buff, so no fourth purchase stacks exposure with White Immolation's Afterburn on Element Divine's area (R1). Gathering Palm repeats Rising Currents' tag on the same two rows under the other Foundation (R1/R4 twin, accepted). Kit reason: every other setup either feeds Element Divine's area (Increase Damage Taken, Afterburn), is off-identity for a burst route (Decrease Damage Taken, Heal) or puts flat Damage on a Hidden Art (R6). The two never compete for one route's Hidden slot and set up different payoffs (Divine Convergence's flat strikes, White Maelstrom's buffs). In capstone-less builds that already hold Fivefold Kindling, Gathering Palm's +3% outranks Rising Currents' +2% (three of fourteen full builds dominated; every node still sits in a non-dominated build). Shakunetsu Sakura's two +3% Increase Damage Given Hidden Arts are the anchor precedent.
The two native burns already pass the 60% per-hit Afterburn cap together, so White Immolation's value depends on alternating Lightning Release and Element Divine.

Divine Convergence and White Immolation share Fivefold Kindling and trade on paper: on the caster's Lightning Release against Fire Release's mark and one burn they come out about even; Divine Convergence leads in the opener and on hits that land while both burns are capped, White Immolation on allies' hits (×1.92 against ×1.82 with Charred Current). Inside both self-buff windows Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel and White Maelstrom with Fivefold Kindling are even on the Damage rows. Rotation and uptime were not simulated. Fivefold Kindling and White Immolation also raise Element Divine's area debuffs on allies in the circle.
Earth Release's Decrease Damage Taken and Water Release's Heal are reachable only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1).

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Fire + Lightning classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Fire and Lightning jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
